cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(t16_leases LANGUAGES CXX)
option(T16_HIP "Build primary integration fixture" OFF)
get_filename_component(ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../.." ABSOLUTE)
set(MATERIAL "")
foreach(INPUT Strata-extensions/native/cache/lease_queue.hpp Strata-extensions/native/cache/lease_queue.cpp Strata-extensions/tests/cache/ledger_fixture.cpp Strata-extensions/tests/cache/hip_lease_fixture.hip)
  file(SHA256 "${ROOT}/${INPUT}" HASH)
  string(APPEND MATERIAL "${INPUT}|${HASH}\n")
endforeach()
string(SHA256 SOURCE_ID "${MATERIAL}")
add_library(t16_leases STATIC lease_queue.cpp ../stats/measurement.cpp)
target_include_directories(t16_leases PUBLIC . ../stats)
target_compile_features(t16_leases PUBLIC cxx_std_17)
add_executable(t16-host ../../tests/cache/ledger_fixture.cpp)
target_link_libraries(t16-host PRIVATE t16_leases)
target_compile_definitions(t16-host PRIVATE T16_SOURCE_ID="${SOURCE_ID}")
set_target_properties(t16-host PROPERTIES RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bundle")
if(T16_HIP)
  enable_language(HIP)
  find_package(hip CONFIG REQUIRED)
  set_source_files_properties("${ROOT}/src/core/device.cu" PROPERTIES LANGUAGE HIP)
  add_executable(t16-hip ../../tests/cache/hip_lease_fixture.hip "${ROOT}/src/core/device.cu")
  target_include_directories(t16-hip PRIVATE "${ROOT}/include/strata/hip_compat" "${ROOT}/include")
  target_compile_definitions(t16-hip PRIVATE STRATA_USE_HIP STRATA_HIP_ARCHS="gfx1100,gfx1201" NOMINMAX WIN32_LEAN_AND_MEAN T16_SOURCE_ID="${SOURCE_ID}")
  target_link_libraries(t16-hip PRIVATE t16_leases hip::host dxgi psapi)
  set_target_properties(t16-hip PROPERTIES HIP_STANDARD 17 RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/bundle")
endif()
